notes.title: Demo Version Level 10: Minor Adjustments
notes.notes:
The position of a urinal in level 10 of the demo version is extremely unclear, I was wrong.
Now it has been corrected. I urgently added two, and now there are six urinals available for use.
However, the official version may undergo adjustments later. It is expected that the playable levels will be increased to 80 when it is released, and the difficulty and quantity of levels will be continuously optimized thereafter.
The current goal is to create at least 100 levels! Wish me good luck, wish my hair good luck, and wish everyone a smooth urination!
